column1: # STAC Build — every model weight of the pod: where it lives, where it comes from, its sha256 and size.

# kind: hf (a file of a Hugging Face repo at a pinned revision) | hfcache (the same, into a hub cache: dest is the
#       cache root, "#main" when its refs/main names that revision — capture_models.py writes these rows) | url | targz |
#       dinov3 (Meta's signed link, DINOV3_URL in .env) | tum (GenRecon's server) | link | copy | convert
# dest: relative to the repo, or absolute. sha256 '-' = not checked (a small file pinned by its revision).
